verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs say Agent Platform can be turned on or off for top-level groups on GitLab.com and for instances on Self-Managed (gitlab-docs-63/49). Its AI governance docs describe Allow, Ask, and Deny policies for agent tools, enforced at execution time for all connecting clients (gitlab-docs-44), with human-in-the-loop approvals (gitlab-docs-40) and per-agent tool selection (gitlab-docs-57). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, evidence of on/off toggles below the top-level group (subgroups or projects), and deeper documentation of how tool policies are scoped and configured.
